title: Patch: count practice earning claims by outcome to tune and police them

```text
# #2884: Patch: count practice earning claims by outcome to tune and police them
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When someone finishes a practice game for rewards, the server replays their game and either pays or refuses with a named reason. Nobody counts those reasons today. After this change the server keeps a tally (how many paid, how many failed for each reason), so the maintainer can see whether honest players are tripping over expiry and whether anyone is hammering the system with forged games. Players see nothing new.

## Why

- The refusal reasons already exist as data (`ClaimRefusal` in `crates/server/src/economy/practice.rs`: unknown/expired/already-claimed seeds, games that do not fold, unfinished games, voided games, result mismatches) but are only returned to the claimant, never aggregated.
- Two reasons are operationally interesting: `Expired` (seeds lapse after `PRACTICE_SEED_TTL_SECONDS`, one hour in `crates/server/src/config.rs`) measures whether the TTL hurts real players, and `DoesNotFold` means a log that does not replay from its setup, which is what a forged earning-farming attempt looks like against the abuse surface (§9.8) and the daily Jlore cap (R1483000).
- This is new: issue #2749 charts subscription usage (different system, human-only), and no rejected suggestion covers claim telemetry. It builds no dashboard (bot hands those to people): counts out of the existing export/logging path.

## Proposal

- Count claim outcomes (paid plus each `ClaimRefusal`) per day, exposed through the existing offline path (`jackioh-server stats-export` in `crates/server/src/cli/export_records.rs`, which the analysis notebooks already consume), plus a structured log line per refusal for incident lookup. No player-facing surface, no new table reads on the claim hot path beyond a counter increment.
- Document the counts in the economy README/notes beside the practice-seed TTL so a future TTL change has data behind it.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/src/economy/practice.rs` (counting), `crates/server/src/cli/export_records.rs` (export), server tests on the fake store; SPEC §14.8/§9.11 referenced, no rules change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every claim outcome increments exactly one bucket (paid or one of the eight refusals); a test walks all nine.
- [ ] The export answers per-day counts; no per-account data leaves with them.
- [ ] Claim latency does not regress (the counting rides the existing transaction, no extra round trips).
- [ ] A forged-log claim is still refused exactly as today, and now also visible in the `DoesNotFold` bucket.

## Size and risks

Small: server only, a few files; likely `difficulty:easy`. Risk is scope creep into a live dashboard or per-account tracking; both are explicitly out (aggregate counts only).

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41574465418)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The server persists a per-UTC-day tally of every practice claim outcome — `paid` plus each of the eight `ClaimRefusal` reasons — incrementing exactly one bucket per claim inside the claim's own transaction, emitting one structured `practice.claim.refused` log line per refusal, and answering per-day counts (no per-account data) from `jackioh-server stats-export --claims`. Player-facing behavior, refusal answers, and claim latency are unchanged.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/migrations/0077_practice_claim_counts.sql` | new | `public.practice_claim_counts(day date, outcome text, count bigint)`, outcome/count checks, PK `(day, outcome)`, RLS on with no policy/grant, comments |
| `crates/server/src/db/migrate.rs` | change | Register `("0077_practice_claim_counts.sql", include_str!(…))` after the 0076 tuple |
| `crates/server/src/economy/practice.rs` | change | `pub const CLAIM_PAID_BUCKET: &str = "paid"`; `impl ClaimRefusal { pub fn bucket(self) -> &'static str }` with 8 arms |
| `crates/server/src/economy/store.rs` | change | `PracticeClaimCount`, `claim_count_day`, `EconomyTables::practice_claim_counts`, `Tx::economy_practice_claim_count` / `economy_practice_claim_counts`, `pg::practice_claim_count` / `practice_claim_counts`, `fake::` same |
| `crates/server/src/api/practice.rs` | change | Count + `practice.claim.refused` log at each refusal decision; count `paid` in `pay`; `mark_refused` takes `reason` and counts only on a changed row |
| `crates/server/src/cli/export_records.rs` | change | `--claims` flag, `read_claim_counts`, `render_claim_counts`, branch in `export_records`, `USAGE` line |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | 3 insertions: Economy-row sentence, migration 0077 paragraph after 0071's, `--claims` sentence in the `stats-export` paragraph |
| `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` | change | `practice_claim_counts_one_bucket_per_outcome_per_day` + list registration |
| `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs` | change | `claim_outcomes_count_paid_and_each_refusal` |
| `crates/server/tests/store/card_stats.rs` | change | New `mod claim_counts_export` with `claim_counts_export_round_trip` |
| `crates/server/tests/store/migrations_pinned.rs` | change | `("0077_practice_claim_counts.sql", "<checksum>")` row |
| `crates/server/tests/sql/01_schema_invariants.sql` | change | `'practice_claim_counts'` in expected array (before `'practice_seeds'`); 0077 in the table-adding comment |
| `crates/server/tests/sql/43_practice_claim_counts.sql` | new | Shape/RLS/re-apply checks mirroring `39_practice_settles.sql` |
| `crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh` | change | Register `43_practice_claim_counts` beside 39's entries |

Must not touch: `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/cards`, `apps/web`, `e2e`, anything under `spec/` (no ruling: telemetry answers no undecided rules question), `PracticeOutcome`/`practice_seeds_settled_check` semantics, the `practice_seeds` prune, `Cargo.toml`/lockfiles, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing sections (cited in code comments only): SPEC §14.8 (R1303000–R1303003, R1483000, R1688000, R2422000), §9.11 (R1044001 offline path), §9.8 (forgery abuse surface).

## Steps

1. Migration: write `crates/server/migrations/0077_practice_claim_counts.sql` in 0071's style (header comment, `create table if not exists`, `enable row level security`, `revoke all … from public, anon, authenticated`, closing role summary). Columns: `day date not null`, `outcome text not null`, `count bigint not null default 1`; `practice_claim_counts_outcome_check` pins the 9 bucket strings below; `practice_claim_counts_count_check` requires `count > 0`; `primary key (day, outcome)`. No purge: 9 rows/day of aggregate data needs none (decision, rejected alternative: a retention constant + purge).
2. Register it in `crates/server/src/db/migrate.rs` after the 0076 tuple, same shape as the 0071 lines.
3. In `crates/server/src/economy/practice.rs`, add `pub const CLAIM_PAID_BUCKET: &str = "paid"` and `impl ClaimRefusal::bucket()` returning `economy_off`, `unknown_seed`, `already_claimed`, `expired`, `does_not_fold`, `not_finished`, `voided`, `result_mismatch` (matching the enum's snake_case serde names). No change to `ClaimRefusal` variants or answers.
4. In `crates/server/src/economy/store.rs`: add `PracticeClaimCount { day: String, outcome: String, count: i64 }`; add `pub fn claim_count_day(at: i64) -> String` computing UTC `YYYY-MM-DD` via the `time` crate (both stores call it, so pg and fake agree); add `EconomyTables::practice_claim_counts: Vec<PracticeClaimCount>`; add `Tx::economy_practice_claim_count(&mut self, bucket: &str, at: i64)` and `Tx::economy_practice_claim_counts(&mut self)` beside the `economy_practice_seed_*` methods using `economy_dispatch!`; implement `pg::practice_claim_count` as one `insert … on conflict (day, outcome) do update set count = count + 1` binding `claim_count_day(at)` as `::date`, and `pg::practice_claim_counts` as `select day::text, outcome, count … order by day, outcome`; mirror both in `fake::` on the new field with `call(f, "economy.practiceClaims.count")` / `"economy.practiceClaims.list"`.
5. In `crates/server/src/api/practice.rs`, count exactly where each outcome is decided, each as one extra statement in the already-open transaction (no new begin/commit on the burn/verify/pay path): `EconomyOff` (open a short tx, count, commit, then refuse), `UnknownSeed`, `AlreadyClaimed` (both the `claimed_at` arm and the claim-CAS-false arm), and `Expired` (count + commit the open tx before each `refused` return); each arm also logs `log_info!("practice.claim.refused", json!({"seed": claim.seed, "reason": reason}))` with no profile id. Change `mark_refused` to take `reason: ClaimRefusal` and count its bucket in its own tx only when the settle UPDATE changed the row; log the refusal line in `settle`'s `Err(reason)` arm. In `pay`, count `CLAIM_PAID_BUCKET` in the same tx before commit (only on the `Some` path). In `post_claim`'s `Settlement::Already` arm, log `already_claimed` without counting (the winning settle already counted it; decision, rejected alternative: counting answers).
6. In `crates/server/src/cli/export_records.rs`: add `--claims` to `parse_export_args` (bail the usage when combined with `--source`/`--mode`/`--patch`, since counts have no such filters); add `read_claim_counts` (begin, `economy_practice_claim_counts`, commit) and `render_claim_counts` writing one `{"day","outcome","count"}` JSON object per line, rows already ordered; branch `export_records` on the flag and print `stats:export: wrote N claim-count rows to …`; extend `USAGE`. Output carries day/outcome/count only — never seeds, profiles, or logs.
7. Docs in `crates/server/README.md`: append a counts sentence to the Economy-table practice sentence (buckets, UTC day, `practice_claim_counts`), a migration-0077 paragraph after 0071's, and a `--claims` sentence in the `stats-export` paragraph beside the `PRACTICE_SEED_TTL_SECONDS` behavior.
8. SQL checks: add the checksum row in `migrations_pinned.rs` (get it from the pinned test's failure output), `'practice_claim_counts'` in `01_schema_invariants.sql`, new `43_practice_claim_counts.sql` mirroring 39's column/check/index/RLS/re-apply assertions, and its entries in `run.sh` mirroring 39's.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`, `practice_claim_counts_one_bucket_per_outcome_per_day`: through `q!`, increment all nine buckets (`paid` + eight `ClaimRefusal::bucket()` values) on two days, assert `economy_practice_claim_counts` returns exactly those rows, then increment one and assert its count is 2. This is the test that walks all nine. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store practice_claim_counts`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs`, `claim_outcomes_count_paid_and_each_refusal`: using the existing `insert`/`claim`/`play`/`refusal` helpers, drive `economy_off` (via `economy_app(false)`), `unknown_seed`, `already_claimed` (claim twice), `expired` (inserted old seed), `paid` (honest game), `does_not_fold` (tampered log — the forged-log case), `not_finished` (empty log), `result_mismatch` (flipped result); assert each answer is exactly today's (`refusal("…")` / paid shape) and the store counts match; assert `logs.named("practice.claim.refused")` holds the refusal reasons. `voided` is covered at store level only — no voided-game fixture exists and building one is out of scope (decision, rejected alternative: a Glitch-voided end-to-end game). Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::practice::claim_outcomes_count`.
- `crates/server/tests/store/card_stats.rs`, new `mod claim_counts_export`, `claim_counts_export_round_trip`: seed counts, export to a temp dir file (copy the `r378_…` tempdir pattern), assert the lines parse to the expected rows and the text contains no seed or profile id. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store claim_counts_export`.
- Checks: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store migrations_pinned`; `sh crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh` (needs Docker `postgres:16`; CI's `db` job also runs it). No `spec check` (no ruling added or cited) and no catalog checks (no card/catalog change).

## Done when

- [ ] Each of the nine outcomes increments exactly one bucket; the contract test walks all nine green on fake and Postgres.
- [ ] `stats-export --claims` answers per-day counts with no per-account data; export test green.
- [ ] No new begin/commit on the burn/verify/pay path (one extra statement in the open tx); refusal answers and pay math byte-identical.
- [ ] Forged-log claim still refuses `does_not_fold` and appears in that bucket.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, the three test commands above, and the SQL suite pass (or a red check is reported, not hidden).

## Risks

- Double counting from the live-vs-sweep race: guarded by counting only when the settle UPDATE changes the row; `Already` counts nothing.
- Fake/PG day divergence: both go through `claim_count_day`; the contract test runs on both.
- Day-boundary skew: buckets key on settle/count time (UTC), documented in README; TTL analysis joins on day, not exact time.
- Privacy: counts table and export hold no account, seed, or log data; the log line holds seed + reason only, like `practice.claim.verified`.
- Retention: the `practice_seeds` prune must not touch the counts table; counts accumulate at ~9 rows/day.

## Open questions

None blocking. One standing choice for the maintainer: counts are kept indefinitely (trivial size); if a retention window is ever wanted, it is a new `*_RETENTION_DAYS` constant plus a purge line, not part of this change.
```
